heard.text: This driver is trying to deliver an enslaved bear directly into the hands of sadistic zoo owners.
How did you piss these guys off so bad?
I didn't do shit! I'm just doing my job. It's a fuckin' bear! What am I gonna do here? Let it out?
You! You are oppressing our sister of the north's right to roam!

captions: Bro is just doing his job
title: These protesters will free the bear
what: Bear protesters block an Animal Services truck: 'This driver is trying to deliver an enslaved bear into the hands of sadistic zoo owners.' Driver: 'I didn't do shit! I'm just doing my job.
